sources.title: BERT (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Bidirectional encoder representations from transformers (BERT) is a language model introduced in October 2018 by researchers at Google. [2][3] It learns to represent text as a sequence of vectors using self-supervised learning.

sources.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language ...
sources.snippet: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers.
